# JKKN College of Arts and Science

> Autonomous institution affiliated to Periyar University, offering 34 UG, PG and PhD programmes in Arts, Science and Commerce. Located on NH-544, Komarapalayam, near Erode, Tamil Nadu 638183, India.

<!-- version: 2026-09-04 -->
<!-- canonical: https://cas.jkkn.ac.in/ -->
<!-- full reference: https://cas.jkkn.ac.in/llms-full.txt -->

## About

JKKN College of Arts and Science (CAS JKKN) is an autonomous college established in 1974 as part of J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions (founded 1952). The college is spread across 15 acres on the Salem-Coimbatore Highway (NH-544) and serves 1,685 students (NIRF 2025 submission, AY 2023-24). It is affiliated to Periyar University and accredited by NAAC. It was originally named Alamelu Angappan College for Women and became co-educational in 2008. It is a donation-free institution offering merit-based admissions.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 1974 (parent trust: 1952)
- Status: Autonomous (UGC-granted)
- Affiliation: Periyar University, Salem
- Accreditation: NAAC Accredited
- Campus: 15 acres, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District
- Students: 1,685 (NIRF 2025 submission, AY 2023-24)
- Faculty: 121 on roll, 52 with a Ph.D. (NIRF 2025 submission)
- Programmes: 19 UG + 12 PG + 3 Ph.D. (34 total)
- Location: NH-544, between Salem and Coimbatore
- Nearest towns and cities (approx. road distance): Bhavani (~4-5 km), Pallipalayam (~14 km), Sankagiri (~15-20 km), Tiruchengode (~20 km), Erode (~22 km), Perundurai (~27-30 km), Gobichettipalayam (~35-40 km), Salem (~55-58 km), Namakkal (~55-60 km), Rasipuram (~60 km)

## Programmes Offered

### Undergraduate (UG) — Aided
- B.A. English
- B.A. History
- B.Com.
- B.Sc. Chemistry
- B.Sc. Mathematics
- B.Sc. Zoology

### Undergraduate (UG) — Self-Finance
- B.A. English
- B.B.A.
- B.C.A.
- B.Com. (Accounting & Finance)
- B.Com. (Banking & Insurance)
- B.Com. (Computer Applications)
- B.Sc. Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
- B.Sc. Computer Science
- B.Sc. Computer Science (Cyber Security)
- B.Sc. Microbiology
- B.Sc. Physics
- B.Sc. Textile & Fashion Designing
- B.Sc. Visual Communication

### Postgraduate (PG) — Aided
- M.A. History
- M.C.A.
- M.Com.
- M.Sc. Chemistry
- M.Sc. Computer Science
- M.Sc. Physics
- M.Sc. Zoology

### Postgraduate (PG) — Self-Finance
- M.A. English
- M.Com.
- M.Sc. Computer Science
- M.Sc. Computer Science (Data Analytics)
- M.Sc. Mathematics

### Doctoral (Ph.D.)
- Ph.D. Chemistry
- Ph.D. Tamil
- Ph.D. Zoology

## Parent Organization

J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions — a multi-institution educational group comprising 7 colleges and 2 schools including Dental, Pharmacy, Nursing, Engineering, Allied Health Sciences, Education, and two schools (Matriculation HSS and CBSE).

- [Group website](https://jkkn.ac.in): J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions

## Facilities

- Multi-specialty teaching hospital on the group campus
- Central library with digital access
- Computer labs with modern infrastructure
- Auditorium and seminar halls
- Hostel (separate for boys and girls)
- Sports complex with indoor stadium and gymnasium
- Transport from Erode, Salem, Namakkal and surrounding areas
- Food court and bank/post office on campus
